_comment: Voice-over for the submission video, one entry per beat of tests/demo.spec.ts. scripts/make-video.mjs speaks each line with Piper, the demo waits for each line to finish before the next beat, and the same text is burned in as captions.
title: SpatialDesk Command Center
subtitle: A hands-first workspace for Meta Quest, with an AI agent that acts, explains, and can be undone.

beats.text: SpatialDesk is a workspace you wear. Before I put the headset on, I describe my day in my own words. No forms.
Inside, the board I'm working on sits within arm's reach, and everything else waits at the sides.
First-timers get three hands-only steps that teach the basics in under a minute. I've done them, so I skip.
One tap on Plan my day. Amazon Nova 2 Lite answers with a single tool call, and the same Kotlin engine that runs in the headset checks every step.
Nothing changes until I say so. Each step says what it will do, and why.
One tap applies the whole plan: a Today board in front of me, and a twenty-five minute focus timer. One undo would take it all back.
By hand it's just as direct. Pick a card up, drop it in Doing, and it snaps into place. Every target is tested against hand-tracking jitter.
In this video timers run in seconds: add fast to the link to do the same. When the block ends, the agent notices on its own.
It knows the report isn't finished, because the app tells it how much of the estimate is used. So it suggests a short break, not a false done.
I accept with one tap. The agent never acts without me.
The AI log shows everything the agent did: each step with its reason, and its own undo.
Any single step can be undone, even after later changes. Anything that depended on it goes too, and the app says so.
High contrast, sound cues and reading plans aloud are one tap away, and they are remembered.
And if I move, Bring to me gathers the workspace around me again.
SpatialDesk. Every claim is checked automatically: frame budgets on a throttled CPU, hand-tracking noise, and an agent with guardrails. Open the link: there is nothing to install.
